gaps.explanation: The governmental funds statement (trimmed p5) prints a Debt Service Fund column. The trim has no schedule for it: p14-21 hold the General Fund, Street, Sales Tax, LB840 and CDBG budget schedules, the nonmajor combining statement and the General Fund departments. So none of its lines are in detail[]. Its printed revenues are Property 307,192 and Other tax 715, Total revenues 307,907. Check: 3,338,158 + 307,907 = 3,646,065, which equals the statement.

gaps.explanation: The statement's Total Governmental Funds column (p5) prints Transfers in (out) 1,158,487, net of the transfers between governmental funds. The fund columns are General 1,168,055, Street (22,330), Sales Tax (18,000) and CDBG 30,762. detail[] records them gross per fund. Transfers in: General Fund Administrative 1,150,055 + Park 18,000 (p20-21, together 1,168,055) + CDBG 30,762 (p18) = 1,198,817. Transfers out: Street (22,330) (p15) + Sales Tax (18,000) (p16) = 40,330. 1,198,817 - 40,330 = 1,158,487. The gap is only gross vs net, so there is no fix.
